output.summary: Lean Office rerun of a stopped task (M15/V17/D25, G3 2026-10-27, option A). POST /api/tasks/:id/rerun and a [다시 실행] dialog on a stopped task's detail: the new task is created exactly like a new task, its rerun link (task_reruns, created on open for old lean DBs) is stored in the same transaction with ALREADY_RERUN and NOT_STOPPED re-checked there, and only then the stopped task is cancelled through the engine's own cancel; a cancel failure keeps the new task (previousCancelled=false, logged). Detail gains risk/rerunOf/rerunBy. Engine, Claw Office, decisions and queue unchanged. TDD: RED office 7/7 (rerun missing), schema 1/1, server 2, web 4, office risk 1, then GREEN; after review a race test went RED before the in-transaction re-check. Moved onto main 187431a (PR #32 and #34 merged). Simplification: note() and riskOf() helpers replace duplicated code; no other change.
